name: unsafe fn drop_in_place (self)
rule: `NonNull::drop_in_place` may be used to drop pinned data when `T` is not `repr(packed)`; pinned data must not be moved before it is dropped.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { unsafe fn drop_in_place (self) }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it provides no observations for pinning, `repr(packed)`, or movement before drop.
